title: Quality Assurance in Another World
description: When a dragon attacks a peaceful village, it’s not the beast that perplexes resident Nikola, but the man who comes to their aid. Haga, member of a secret royal team of investigators, intrigues her with his eccentric ways. It may be due to the fact he’s a real-life QA debugger and this world is a VR game! With Haga by her side, Nikola’s inspired to venture out and learn her world’s true nature.

episodes_data.title: Quality Assurance in Another World Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Nikola is content to live a normal life in her small, tranquil village... until the day a curious man named Haga arrives. Haga claims to be "investigating" the world, and his quest to do so will open Nikola's eyes to all kinds of unseen wonders!

episodes_data.title: Quality Assurance in Another World Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After what she's been through, Nikola is now determined to join Haga on his quest to debug the world and become a King's Seeker herself! Haga has no idea what to make of this development, so he reluctantly agrees to take her with him.

episodes_data.title: Quality Assurance in Another World Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After a nasty encounter with some fellow debuggers, Haga takes Nikola to the Advent Altar to teach her an invaluable lesson about abusing the power of the debugger stones.

episodes_data.title: Quality Assurance in Another World Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Haga and Nikola stumble across a buggy forgotten village in the remote reaches of the country. There, they meet an interesting character by the name of Isora Amano who has some alarming information on the other debuggers.
